item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01895","case1_error":"Equates Roger’s current experience to his retirement target, ignoring Tom’s stated experience relation.","case2_error":"Reports the initial candy total instead of the candies remaining after Carlos eats the yellow candies.","reason":"The first imposes an invalid current-experience equation; the second calculates and reports the wrong requested quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01896","case1_error":"Divides days by words instead of words by days to calculate words per day.","case2_error":"Treats 10 hours over five days as 10 hours per day, omitting division by five.","reason":"The first reverses a rate’s numerator and denominator; the second mistakes a multiday total for a daily rate.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01897","case1_error":"Uses living alone in the new apartment as the savings baseline; the intended baseline is ambiguous.","case2_error":"Omits the 250 papers delivered daily, calculating recycling proceeds for only one paper per day.","reason":"The first is valid under a plausible reading of 'living alone'; the second clearly omits the daily paper multiplicity.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01898","case1_error":"Reverses the stated cutting chronology and labels 143 cm final; the question itself inconsistently describes which boards are shortened.","case2_error":"Omits the $2 Sunday newspaper from weekly spending.","reason":"The board question is materially inconsistent: shortening each board equally cannot equalize unequal lengths. That ambiguity prevents a reliable mechanism comparison.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01899","case1_error":"Gives an unsupported final $12,000 after correctly setting up $3,000 + $276 × 48 + $7,000.","case2_error":"Subtracts the production cost of one necklace from revenue for 30 necklaces, omitting the other 29 necklaces’ costs.","reason":"The first supplies an unexplained incorrect number after a correct formula; the second uses an incorrect total-cost quantity in its calculation.","judgment":"different"}]}
